ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 10% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous high-intensity white field occupies the central 90% of the fluke; a thin, irregular low-intensity black band defines the entire trailing edge boundary; approximately 12-15 discrete low-intensity circular blobs (spots) are distributed across the white field, primarily in the lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth estimated at 15% of the fluke's vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge, creating a continuous jagged linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending outward from the median notch, concluding in pointed distal tips with a slight upward inflection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast dark pixel clusters located at both the left and right distal tips; multiple individual circular dark spots (<5 pixel diameter) scattered non-uniformly across the high-intensity white surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, horizontal low-intensity linear pixel marks (rake-like disruptions) visible at the central peduncle-fluke junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark-toned clusters of irregular texture at the terminal ends of both lobes; distinct horizontal parallel linear disruptions at the fluke center-base.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive peppered pigmentation pattern consisting of small, high-contrast dark dots on a primary white background.
